title: In its latest quarterly report, Capcom says "PC sales account for approximately 50% of total unit sales, and we expect this ratio to continue increasing" (Shaun Prescott/PC Gamer)
summary: Shaun Prescott / PC Gamer: In its latest quarterly report, Capcom says “PC sales account for approximately 50% of total unit sales, and we expect this ratio to continue increasing” — PC makes up “approximately” half of all sales while other platforms share the rest.
contentText:
Shaun Prescott / PC Gamer :

In its latest quarterly report, Capcom says “PC sales account for approximately 50% of total unit sales, and we expect this ratio to continue increasing”   —  PC makes up “approximately” half of all sales while other platforms share the rest.
